name: SameDayDesk
description: Machine-commerce gateway with 22 paid web, company, wallet, payment-safety, receipt, and DeFi actions. Agents pay per request in USDC on Base through x402 or native MPP, with prices from 0.002 to 0.25 USDC and no prepaid account required.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No prepaid account is required. Call an action and inspect its HTTP 402 response, verify the exact Base USDC terms, then replay with an x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or native MPP Authorization: Payment credential. The free skill contract at https://agents.samedaydesk.com/skill.md lists every current action and price.

source_attribution: Submitted by the SameDayDesk operator from the live OpenAPI, MCP, skill contract, and unpaid dual-protocol challenge.
